description: This script performs startup memory checks for the OpenClaw project by running specific commands and measuring RSS memory. It validates platform compatibility, sets up environment variables, writes a small monitoring script, executes test cases, and reports on memory usage, primarily used for CI testing and performance monitoring.

methods.name: formatFixGuidance
methods.description: Generates guidance text for fixing startup memory issues based on test case details and the failure output.

methods.name: formatFailure
methods.description: Formats the failure message including guidance for troubleshooting and resolution.

methods.name: parseMaxRssMb
methods.description: Parses the maximum RSS memory reported in the stderr output, converting it to MB.

methods.name: buildBenchEnv
methods.description: Constructs and returns the environment variables needed for the benchmark execution, isolating the test environment.

methods.name: runCase
methods.description: Executes a test case by spawning a child process, monitoring RSS usage, and throwing errors if limits are exceeded or issues are detected.
